sources.title: Subgraph densities in signed graphons and the local Sidorenko conjecture
sources.author: László Lovász
sources.inspection: Definitions, Lemma 2.3 and its generalized Cauchy–Schwarz setting, Corollary 2.8, Lemma 2.22, and local-Sidorenko statements inspected. The final manuscript proves its needed three-function inequality directly; it does not invoke the stronger local-Sidorenko theorem.
